svg.text: Valves: flow onto the column and what the sample does
Synthetic run logs put through pycorn.run_log_sections; start: system flow 5 ml/min.
Numbered marks: run-log entries, listed under each case with their stored (elapsed) time; the x axis is the wall clock CADET uses.
1. Injection valve positions and the column by-pass
Direct inject: the column gets the sample flow. System pump waste: 0 (with a warning). Inject: system flow through the loop. By-pass: the column gets nothing.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
60 s elapsed: Injection valve Direct inject
120 s elapsed: Injection valve System pump waste
240 s elapsed: Injection valve Manual load
270 s elapsed: Column position By-pass Down flow
2. Sample to the by-pass, and buffer through the sample pump
Inject while the column is by-passed: to_bypass (priming or checking the sample; UV is not column outlet). Direct inject from the sample inlet's Buffer: buffer, not feed.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
30 s elapsed: Column position By-pass Down flow
120 s elapsed: Column position Position 1 Down flow
180 s elapsed: Injection valve Direct inject
240 s elapsed: Injection valve Manual load
